About

From the engineering halls of Sheffield to the innovation hub of Singapore, and now to the dynamic corridors of Columbia University, I've cultivated a unique perspective on how technology transforms industries and creates value.

At Jaguar Land Rover, I worked within a 50+ member Agile squad to deliver next-generation vehicle software, including the Lane Centring ADAS feature that enhances safety for over 100,000 vehicles. This experience taught me that great products emerge from the intersection of technical excellence and deep user empathy.

Today, I'm pursuing my Master's in Technology Management at Columbia, where I serve as Treasurer of TIBA, Director of Finance at the Venture Capital Club, and Executive Board Member of the Product Management Club—bridging the worlds of technology, finance, and entrepreneurship.
